newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli Chambers of Commerce re-elect Gillerman.
newsitem.headline: Israeli Chambers of Commerce re-elect Gillerman.

text.p: Danny Gillerman, a vocal critic of the Bank of Israel's monetary policy, was re-elected president of the Federation of Israeli Chambers of Commerce, the organisation announced on Monday.
It said Gillerman won 75 percent of the vote at its annual conference.
Last week Gillerman said high interest rates imposed by the central bank were responsible for the slowing Israeli economy. He has called repeatedly for the Bank of Israel to lower rates.
Economic growth slowed to an estimated 4.4 percent in 1996 from 7.1 percent in 1995.
